comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments with the same null/empty rules. But 0 requires a specific verifiable PROCEDURAL example (an actual procedure, process, rule or protocol, e.g. how a legal or institutional process works). 1 accepts any concrete specific case (a named person, event, place, policy or personal/local situation). 1 is much broader: a named person or event that is not a procedure qualifies for 1 but not for 0. This is a broad construct versus a materially narrower subtype, so they are distinct.
